Basil changes mood with what's happening (tab 8). 2. The subtitle bar shows his last line and takes typed questions. 3. The output area shows tonight's dinner, the week or the current recipe. 4. The chat bubble opens the full conversation. 5 to 7. Cook mode keeps one step on screen, with the reason behind it and its own timer. 8. Typed and spoken questions go to the same askChef call. 9. Photo import is the multimodal Gemma call, and the recipe it returns is checked for allergens before it's shown." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="220" width="1620" x="40" y="720" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Notes
1. Basil changes mood with what's happening (tab 8). 2. The subtitle bar shows his last line and takes typed questions. 3. The output area shows tonight's dinner, the week or the current recipe. 4. The chat bubble opens the full conversation. 5 to 7. Cook mode keeps one step on screen, with the reason behind it and its own timer. 8. Typed and spoken questions go to the same askChef call. 9. Photo import is the multimodal Gemma call, and the recipe it returns is checked for allergens before it's shown.
